personality_one_liner: Trustworthy, breathable, and heavily reliant on structural whitespace to let high-quality property photos shine, anchored by warm brick-terracotta accents.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous vertical breathing room. Cards and list items should feel comfortably padded (md or lg), never crammed. Rely on margins and structural padding, not harsh borders.

do's: Use glass effect on the bottom tab bar where the property feed scrolls behind it.
Use glass effect on the fixed bottom CTA container in the property details screen.
Use glass overlay for Floating Action Buttons (FAB) and top header in details screen.
dont's: Do not use glass for property cards in the main feed.
Avoid glass over text-heavy sections or map overlays that require high readability.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Serve as the primary discovery feed with easy access to filters, localities, and prominent property cards.
screens.layout: Sticky header with search bar (invokes bottom sheet). A horizontal scroll section for category chips (Buy, Rent, Plot, Commercial). Below that, a horizontal section for 'Top Localities'. The rest of the screen is a vertical feed of edge-to-edge or comfortably padded property cards (large hero image, floating terracotta price tag, compact tracked-out spec row for Beds/Baths/SqFt, and clear 'Verified' or 'Demo' badges).

states.loading: Skeleton UI for property cards and locality chips.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty house/plot with text 'No properties found for these filters' and a 'Clear Filters' primary CTA.
states.error: Message indicating connection failure with a 'Retry' button.

screens.name: SearchFiltersSheet
screens.purpose: Allow users to refine property searches quickly without leaving the context of the feed.
screens.layout: A bottom sheet popping over the Home screen. Contains pill toggles for Property Type (Buy/Rent, etc.), a slider for Budget, and segmented controls for BHK. Sticky primary 'Apply Filters' CTA at the bottom.

states.loading: N/A - Opens instantly with local state.

screens.name: PropertyDetails
screens.purpose: Provide comprehensive property info, storytelling imagery, and a persistent lead capture action.
screens.layout: Parallax image gallery at the top with a pill page-indicator. Overlay glass header with back and share/save buttons. Below image: primary stats (Price, BHK, Area) and badges. Use progressive disclosure: scroll down to reveal a 4-column Amenities icon grid, a Map/Location snippet, and 'Demo' labeling if active. Crucially, a fixed glass bottom bar with a prominent 'Enquire Now' CTA button.

states.empty: Text indicating the property is no longer available, with a CTA to return to Home.
states.error: Error loading property details, with 'Retry' button.

screens.name: EnquiryFormSheet
screens.purpose: Capture user intent directly from the details screen.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet invoked from Property Details CTA. Simple form (Name, Phone Number, Optional Message) with labels placed above inputs. Sticky 'Send Enquiry' CTA at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.

states.loading: Spinner on the CTA button while submitting.
states.error: Inline error messages for failed form submission.

screens.name: Saved
screens.purpose: A quick-access list of bookmarked properties.
screens.layout: Standard vertical list or 2-column grid of simplified property cards. Header titled 'Saved'.

states.empty: Illustration of a bookmark with 'No saved properties yet' and CTA 'Explore Properties'.

screens.name: MyEnquiries
screens.purpose: Track sent leads and their status.
screens.layout: Vertical list of cards showing the property snippet, date enquired, and a status pill (e.g., Pending, Contacted).

states.empty: Illustration with 'You haven't sent any enquiries yet' and CTA 'Browse Homes'.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage user account, preferences, and language selection.
screens.layout: List-based layout. Shows user info/Google login button at the top. Below, standard rows for settings, including a segmented control for Language Toggle (English / हिंदी) taking effect globally.

states.empty: Guest state showing a prominent 'Login with Google' card.
states.error: Failed to load profile data, Retry button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality with a primary terracotta-brick color to establish a sense of property, earth, and trust, actively avoiding all blues and purples.
Bilingual support is critical: Load both 'Mukta' (Display) and 'Hind' (Text) via expo-font to ensure high-quality Devanagari rendering alongside English.
Implement the Home screen with 'Architectural Daylight' principles: white backgrounds, dark text, and high-impact property images in edge-to-edge or comfortably padded cards.

Include clear 'Verified' badges (using the success color) and 'Demo' labels (using warning/info color) layered on top of the property image cards. Use a top-down vertical gradient scrim on images for readability.

Build the Property Details screen using progressive disclosure: start with the hero gallery and core stats, then follow with an Amenities 4-column matrix, location, and the sticky 'Enquire Now' CTA anchored at the bottom (wrapped in a glass container if content scrolls behind).
Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for both the 'Search Filters' and 'Enquiry Form' to maintain contextual flow without jarring page transitions.
Integrate Google login strictly as requested for the profile flow.
